subject: Signal retention & dashboards — packaging and concession options
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita@NimbusHealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Observability add-on pricing — retention & dashboards questions

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — NimbusHealth's ML ops and product teams found the tracing dashboard very promising. We need a clearer sense of how you price the observability add-ons for production usage before we can take this to procurement. Specific questions: 

- Retention tiers: what are list prices for 30/90/365 day retention (traces + token-level events)?
- Tracing: is there a per-sample or per-trace metering? Any dedup or sampling discounts?
- Advanced dashboards: are these seat-based, or included in an add-on bundle? Can we map to 10 power-users + org readers?
- Pilot: we'd like to run a 4-week pilot on prod traffic with a small credit — do you offer pilot credits?

Also — we're targeting a procurement approval window in the first half of December. If there are standard concession paths for early-stage customers committing to annual spend, please outline them.

Appreciate a concise options matrix we can share with procurement.

Best,
Anita
Anita Shah
Director, Product Operations | NimbusHealth

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita@NimbusHealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing — retention & dashboards questions

Hi Anita — great to hear the demo landed well. Below is a compact options matrix and a path to a concession if Nimbus commits to a 12-month consumption commitment. I attached a short SOW draft and a concession matrix for internal review.

Options (quick list prices, USD / month):

1) Standard Visibility (recommended starter)
- 30-day trace + event retention
- Continuous sampling at 1/100 token rate (configurable)
- Basic dashboarding (shared org dashboards)
- Price: $2,500 / month add-on

2) Extended Visibility (most customers choose this)
- 90-day retention for traces & token events
- Adaptive sampling (dedup + tail-sampling) — effective econ reduction at scale
- Advanced dashboards: 10 power seats + org readers (token-metered otherwise)
- Price: $7,500 / month add-on

3) Enterprise Trace Suite
- 365-day retention, hot+warm tiering
- Full sampling control, tracing ingest SLAs, dedicated tracing cluster option
- Unlimited dashboards with advanced widgets + 24/7 support
- Price: custom (typical starting at $25k / month)

Pilot credits and concessions:
- Pilot: we can offer $10k in pilot credits for a 4-week production pilot (applies against first invoice).
- Concession path: 20% off list for 12-month commit at >=1M tokens/month, or 15% off for 6-month commit at >=750k tokens/month. Waive one-time setup fee up to $5k.

Notes on metering: tracing is billed based on retained trace-events and effective token ingestion after deduping. Sampling strategies materially change cost; we typically model for customers and provide a baseline estimate.

Next steps: if you can share a 2-week traffic sample (redacted) or expected tokens/month and retention target, I can generate a firm pricing estimate and a short SOW.

Attachments: SOW_NimbusHealth_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — East
Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@nimbushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Shah <anita@NimbusHealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2026-11-03T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing — retention & dashboards questions

Markus,

Thanks for the clear breakdown. A few clarifications and asks from procurement/finance: 

- Nimbus is aligned to the 90-day retention target. We like the Extended Visibility tier but need a concession to make the numbers work. Can you stretch to 25% off list for a 12-mo commit?
- Pricing model question: can advanced dashboards be provisioned as a 10-seat bundle (fixed) rather than token-metered? That helps our license budgeting.
- Pilot: would like pilot credits to be refundable (applied as credit) and to include access to the advanced dashboards for the pilot cohort.
- Compliance: please attach SOC2 or pointers to your security docs so procurement can move quickly.

Procurement timeline: decision committee meets 2026-12-10. We need a signed SOW + PO by 2026-12-03 to meet internal cycles.

Regards,
Carlos Vega
VP, Engineering — NimbusHealth
procurement@nimbushealth.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-04T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Observability add-on pricing — NimbusHealth concession request

Team — forwarding Nimbus' ask. Key points: 90-day target, asking for 25% off for 12-mo commit, want 10-seat fixed dashboards, pilot credits applied to first invoice, SOC2 evidence. Procurement deadline 2026-12-03.

My suggested concession (to approve internally):
- Offer: Extended Visibility at 20% off list for 12 months, contingent on 12-month term and >=1M tokens/month commit.
- Dashboard: map advanced dashboards to a 10-seat bundle (flat, included in concession) for first 6 months; revert to token-metering thereafter unless customer purchases additional seats.
- Pilot: $10k pilot credit, applied to first invoice (non-refundable credit).
- Setup: waive $5k onboarding fee.

I've attached a pricing_concession_matrix.xlsx that lays out price impact and NPV. If Legal accepts minimal SOW tweaks, I think this will close by 12/03. Ask: Kim, can you confirm we can go to 20% and seat-bundle trial? Vanessa, please confirm we can waive onboarding fee. Karthik — if we accept seat bundle for 6 months, how does this affect our telemetry capacity planning?

Thanks,
Markus

> On Nov 3, 2026, at 14:18, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@nimbushealth.com> wrote:
> Markus,

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Observability add-on pricing — NimbusHealth concession request

Markus — thanks for the summary. Quick responses: 

- Pricing: Finance can approve 18% off list for 12-month committed ARR at >=1M tokens/month. 20% is a stretch without exec signoff.
- Dashboards: Product is okay to provide a 10-seat advanced dashboard bundle for 6 months as a trial, provided we limit exports and data retention to agreed scope (we'll add that to the SOW).
- Onboarding fee: Can confirm waive up to $5k for this deal.
- SOC2: I'll have security attach the SOC2 report and a short security FAQ for procurement.

Actionables:
- Legal needs a deal_id and the final SOW to spin up the PO-ready doc. Markus, if you can confirm deal_id (I propose DEAL-77821) and finalize token commit numbers, we can prepare the PO/SOW package.

Kim
VP, Pricing & Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita@NimbusHealth.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-13T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing — retention & dashboards questions

Anita / Carlos,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for outlining procurement timelines. Based on internal review we've consolidated a firm offer so you can present it to your committee: 

Final offer (DEAL-77821):
- Product: Extended Visibility (90-day retention) + Advanced Dashboards bundle
- Pricing: $7,500 / month list -> 18% discount -> $6,150 / month
- Commitment: 12 months term, minimum consumption guarantee 1,000,000 tokens / month (true-up at quarter end)
- Pilot: $10,000 pilot credit to be applied to first invoice; pilot includes the 10-seat advanced dashboards for the pilot cohort
- Onboarding: one-time $0 (waived; list $5k)
- Deliverables: short SOW (attached) + SOC2 report and security FAQ.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/espresso/sign/abc123-nimbus-sow — sign by 2026-12-03 to meet your procurement window.

If Nimbus accepts DEAL-77821, we'll prepare the PO-ready SOW and route to Legal. Once signed, we'll schedule a kickoff to provision the dashboard seats and configure sampling strategy (we'll run a traffic model to estimate likely cost at your expected sampling).

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if you want to walk procurement through the concession rationale.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — East
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_NimbusHealth_v1.pdf, pricing_concession_matrix.xlsx
